subject: Annual Calibration & Quiet Role Transitions — Timeline and Manager Bundle
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Annual Calibration & Quiet Role Transitions — Timeline and Manager Bundle

Team,

Following up on our leadership sync — draft plan attached for the annual calibration window plus a small set of low-visibility role transitions we need to execute for a handful of sensitive positions. Goal: avoid wide announcements until managers have signed off and affected ICs have one-on-one conversations.

High level (please read before EOD Thursday):
- Pilot scope: Platform Eng (3 roles), Product Security (1 role).
- Timeline: manager comms + forms out (week of 7/6), manager one-on-ones (7/13-7/20), final changes live (target 7/27).
- Manager bundle includes: manager talking points, template one-on-one script, nominee role map, and escalation matrix.
- Privacy lanes: all manager comms use encrypted doc links; HR/Legal to be looped for any pay or title impacts.
- Fallbacks: if any manager flags risk, we delay that role by one week and route to exec approval.

Attachments: manager_comm_draft_v2.docx, role_mapping_sheet.xlsx, pilot_checklist.pdf

Asks: please review the manager talking points and the escalation matrix and send any edits by Thu 7/2 COB. If you approve the pilot as-is, reply with "pilot ok" and note any teams you prefer we exclude.

I'll schedule a 30-minute review on Friday to collect comments.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of People Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual Calibration & Quiet Role Transitions — Timeline and Manager Bundle

Thanks, Soojin — read and quick notes below. Pilot ok from my side pending minor edits.

- Add a one-week buffer after manager one-on-ones for any unexpected escalations (so final changes move to 8/3 if needed).
- Escalation matrix: add an explicit step for Legal to sign off if title or compensation change > 10%.
- Manager comms: include a short FAQ (2 bullets) about how this affects comp cycles and offers.

I can take point on calibrating talking points for managers of senior ICs (I'll update section 2).

Pilot ok — please include Platform Eng and exclude distributed infra for this run.

Agree with Laura on the buffer week. Also recommend we run the pilot with one manager per team to limit exposure.

Thanks all — consolidated changes below and next steps.

What I changed from v2:
- Added one-week buffer after manager one-on-ones (new target final changes live 8/3).
- Inserted Legal sign-off step for >10% comp/title changes.
- Updated manager script opening line to set confidentiality expectation.
- Included a 2-bullet FAQ about comp impact and how offers are handled.

Pilot cadence: run Platform Eng with one manager per team; exclude Distributed Infra as requested. Vivek, noted you as named fallback approver for Platform Eng.

Next steps:
- I'll push manager_comm_draft_v3 to the shared Drive and send encrypted links to managers on 7/6.
- Greenfield will review the escalation matrix for compliance language and confirm by 7/8 (cc'd).
- Tara (Acme HR) — thank you for the benchmarking doc earlier; if you have any red flags on the timeline or comms language please flag in the shared drive comments.

I've attached pilot_checklist.pdf and the updated role_mapping_sheet.xlsx. If no objections, we will proceed to send manager links on 7/6 and begin one-on-ones the week of 7/13.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Soojin
Head of People Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_checklist.pdf, role_mapping_sheet.xlsx
